say:1:1033204001:1.text: It's exceptionally difficult! I'd rather go clear corrupted roots and fight the Thorned Guards again!
say:1:1033204001:1.source_cn: 很难、非常难、特别难！还不如让我去挖腐化根茎，再和荆棘...
say:1:1033204001:1.male: It's exceptionally difficult! I'd rather go clear corrupted roots and fight the Thorned Guards again!
say:1:1033204001:1.female: It's exceptionally difficult! I'd rather go clear corrupted roots and fight the Thorned Guards again!

say:2:1033204002:1.text: Not only do you have to keep a constant smile, but also be careful to maintain a gentle tone. It's hard to placate them... Especially for someone like me, who's better at fighting!
say:2:1033204002:1.source_cn: 你是不知道，面对难民的时候，不仅要保持笑容，还要放轻语...
say:2:1033204002:1.male: Not only do you have to keep a constant smile, but also be careful to maintain a gentle tone. It's hard to placate them... Especially for someone like me, who's better at fighting!
say:2:1033204002:1.female: Not only do you have to keep a constant smile, but also be careful to maintain a gentle tone. It's hard to placate them... Especially for someone like me, who's better at fighting!

say:3:1033204003:1.text: After I bring these two back to camp, I'll apply to the Captain for a transfer...
say:3:1033204003:1.source_cn: 等我把这两位老人带回营地，和队长申请调岗试试吧……
say:3:1033204003:1.male: After I bring these two back to camp, I'll apply to the Captain for a transfer...
say:3:1033204003:1.female: After I bring these two back to camp, I'll apply to the Captain for a transfer...
